snippet.title: The Corn Maze: Rebirth - Teaser Trailer 1
snippet.description:
Step into the darkness once again…
The Corn Maze: Rebirth is coming back bigger, scarier, and more twisted than ever.

Prepare for intense survival horror, chilling secrets, and a maze that never stops hunting.

🔥 Wishlist it now on Steam and be the first to escape:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3906400/The_Corn_Maze_Rebirth/

🆓 Download the free demo for The Corn Maze: Rebirth:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3906400/The_Corn_Maze_Rebirth/
